{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]

# Count how many unique patients and how many rows there are
unique_patients = data['patient_id'].nunique()
num_rows = len(data)

# Show number of duplicates and how many times each appears
duplicate_counts = duplicate_patients['patient_id'].value_counts()

unique_patients, num_rows, duplicate_counts.head(10)"}
